preprocessing: 1. lowercase the whole text (Python str.lower(); Java: toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
2. keep only the first max_len CODE POINTS (not UTF-16 chars)
3. map each code point to its index in vocab.json; unknown -> unk_index
4. pad with pad_index up to max_len

output.postprocessing: softmax is already inside the model; scam if output[1] >= threshold
